page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword at right below the last line.

main_text.l: ut mei ergo Eminentiam tuam exora-
tum sperem? Sed optimi Cardinalis Be-r-
allii Parentis & fundatoris nostri, quem ad supremum
Cardinalatus dignitatem summus Pontifex Patrinus tuus pera-
manter evexit, singularia in Ecclesiam
Catholicam merita apud eminentiam
tuam intercedunt; intercedit quoque,
& quam humili potest cum obsequio, hoc
beneficium efflagitat pedibus tuis, mecum provoluta
congregatio nostra, quæ immatura parentis sui morte, pu-
pilla patronoque orba, & rerum inops
in sinum tuum confugit, benevolentiæ-
que tuæ asilum invocat, vere enim & sin-
cere dicam, Congreg. nostra domus præ-
sertim Parisiensis à Parente suo pietatem,
humilitatem, animumque in Ecclesiæ
Catholicæ ministerium propensissimum,
& in sedem Apostolicam devinctissi-
mum hausit & expressit; sed opes, qui-
bus sustentaretur, & ad scopum, in quem
collimat, assequendum juvaretur, par-
cissime accepit: ideo licet Abbatia illa
paucorum reditum sit Sacerdotium,

page.notes: Printed "ut" at the start is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Page number "49" is uncertain (the second digit is stylised). Running head "BARBERINO" is in small capitals in the scan. Spacing is missing in "sertim Parisiensis" ("fertimParifienfis" on the scan), and the first letter of "sertim" may be a long f. The scan shows a stray mark at the left margin, which is not printed text.
